name: Tomo
tagline: the inward-circle visionary · Devcon team · designer of the Infinite Garden's world
bio: Known to the public record as Tomo Saito — 'a designer at the Ethereum Foundation. Creating the world of the Infinite Garden and more!' (Devcon speaker page). Creative Direction across the Devcon Archive; Devcon SEA talk 'Ethereum Culture Expanding in the Infinite Garden.' In the orchestra's books: Tomo, Carlota & the Devcon team embraced the Music Space as team activation (2026), and Tomo's vision is the Devcon music circle facing INWARD. Shaka's haiku — 'Open source music, every voice is a node, sounds of consensus' — was written for Aya & Tomo.
quote: When did a circle of strangers first sing back at you?
quote_note: the question the orchestra keeps warm for him (Every Voice a Node season plan)
songs_note: Featured composition = the inward-facing circle itself: stage → circle, audience → voices, performance → consensus. Nothing appears on this node without Tomo's blessing, item by item.
